03:00 Keynote (Jordan) 10m
13:00 Breakout lightning intros (hosts) 3m

Kai: I'll spin a staging endpoint and short demo clips. Endpoint: https://staging.redwood-demo/1755, ephemeral key at rehearsal.

ops-bot: Rehearsal event created for 2025-05-15T16:00Z. Runbook link posted. Recording enabled.
